title: Hitomi-chan is Shy With Strangers
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hitomi Takano, a very tall first-year with sharp teeth and a frightening face, is actually painfully shy and wants to make friends. Second-year Yuu Usami, who tutors her in math, sees past her looks, and the two slowly move from friendship toward romance. His outgoing younger sister Kaoru rounds out the school comedy.
life_message: Kindness that looks past appearances lets a shy person open up and find friendship and love.

content.note: Slapstick at most; Hitomi's scary look is the running joke, not actual fighting.
Slow romance; ANN review calls the fan service excessive, with focus on Hitomi's large breasts (Wikipedia; MangaDex 'suggestive'). No nudity reported.
Social anxiety and shyness handled gently.
Body-focused teasing between girls played as comedy.
